About Amerbis

A reliable strategic partner for agricultural labor

2
Countries served: United States and Argentina
20+
Years recruiting & managing seasonal agricultural workers

Amerbis Inc. is a licensed Farm Labor Contractor (FLC) with over 20 years of experience recruiting and managing seasonal workers, dedicated to providing reliable, highly skilled, and experienced labor to support agricultural operations across the United States.

With access to a deep pool of experienced workers from Argentina and Mexico who have extensive hands-on experience in agriculture, we deliver seasonal crews that combine productivity, technical expertise, and operational reliability.

Our workers are widely recognized for their strong work ethic, adaptability, and experience in precision agricultural operations — from seed research and row crops to livestock and dairy, harvest and packing. Our crews are prepared to support the critical stages of your operation, helping you maintain efficiency during peak periods of the season.

Our teams integrate quickly into existing operations, requiring minimal supervision while maintaining consistent productivity and helping ensure that operational timelines and field activities are completed efficiently.
